subject.title: Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District Board, Trustee Area 5

text: Primary election winner with 70% of the vote!
I am a lifelong educator committed to improving public education, currently serving as a full-time college professor at San Diego Mesa College.
Community Colleges provide the on-going education needed for job training, career advancement, personal growth and transfer to a four year college.
I will continue fighting for community colleges to remain affordable, and provide college transfer and career training opportunities, especially for our veterans.

I will continue to ensure our East County tax dollars are spent wisely, with transparency and accountability. I will advocate to ensure the District continues to receive clean financial audits each year as certified by an independent accounting firm.
My community service includes volunteering at the Monarch School serving unhoused youth, a Stand Down Volunteer in the Veteran’s Village of San Diego, and a Public Library Literacy Tutor.

I am not a politician seeking higher office. I am a career educator seeking to ensure our East County students receive the college transfer preparation and workforce training they need to be successful members of our community.
I am endorsed by the American Federation of Teachers, the San Diego Labor Council, and current Community College Board Members.
I respectfully ask for your vote for my election to the Grossmont-Cuyamaca Community College District Governing Board.
